ontario-informal.name: Town parking lot
ontario-informal.notes: Parking lot behind Timmys/McDonald's, in front of a soccer feild and walking trails. No sign saying you can't park overnight.

ontario-informal.name: Relai 381
ontario-informal.notes: We have water available and it is possible to park overnight.

ontario-informal.name: Walmart
ontario-informal.notes:
Nice little Walmart close to Erie beach.
quiet and clean.

ontario-informal.name: Nepean Creek East
ontario-informal.notes:
Quiet municipal parking lot surrounded by green space in a business park. Formally called Nepean Creek East Parking. Large gravel lot for Nepean Creek Park. Surrounded by large sports fields and some trees in all directions. Easy access to main routes via Colonnade Road. 

Features a clean composting toilet and 5 bar LTE service. Lot is also connected to a small dog park. Plenty of room for larger rigs. No parking restrictions overnight, had a very peaceful night here. 

Please keep this area beautiful and use the provided garbage cans to dispose of your waste. Further parking information can be obtained by calling the City of Ottawa at 611.

There is a potable water fountain at the playground behind the soccer fields in the east.

ontario-informal.name: London, Ont-Flying J Gas Station
ontario-informal.notes: Multiple very long lanes for RV to accomodate big rigs and youyou, propane, dump station

ontario-informal.name: Port Carling Foodland
ontario-informal.notes: Employees parking lot not used at night. Municipal park close by was a great place to spend the evening waiting for the store to close. Tim Hortons next door for amenities. Probably busy in summer.

ontario-informal.name: Walmart Supercentre
ontario-informal.notes:
It is allowed to stay overnight with a motorhome. You can use the washrooms during the opening hours (7 am - 11 pm).
There is free wifi in the store.
Bright at night with a lot of headlights. People played frisbee there at night. Was not so quiet...we couldn't sleep well !

ontario-informal.name: Rest Stop at 614 turn off
ontario-informal.notes: [cyclist]A small rest stop at the junction with pit toilet and picnic tables. It would be hard to park an RV there, but one arrived during the night and stayed. It is at the junction so very loud at night, specially as there is a truck stop on the other side of the hwy 17. Not a quiet place, but goes as an emergency.

ontario-informal.name: Rideau Canal Lock 43,44 - Upper Brewers
ontario-informal.notes: Parking associated with Upper Brewers lockstation on the Rideau Canal.  Parking lot is at the end of Canal road.  If the canal is open, there is a $5 per person charge for camping at the lockstation.  Far enough from the highway that there is minimal noise.

ontario-informal.name: Walmart
ontario-informal.notes: The usual. Fairly quiet. Everything's in French.

ontario-informal.name: Flesherton arena and library.
ontario-informal.notes: really nice spot behind library near picnic area. Covered picnic table, Porta potty, internet open from the library, grassy area, garbage can .... what more could you ask for?

ontario-informal.name: Walmart
ontario-informal.notes: Had a good night's sleep. Walmart open 7-10. Didn't ask for permission since we came past the opening hours, but seemed to be ok. Big parking lot together with Home Depot, we stayed in front of Walmart.

ontario-informal.name: Walmart
ontario-informal.notes: Nothing special, but good for overnight parking. Store open from 7am to 11pm.

ontario-informal.name: rest area in the green
ontario-informal.notes:
Rest area with tables

100m distance is a gaz station I think 24h open.

Close to the road but ok.
A few mosquitoes around

ontario-informal.name: Chandos Lake
ontario-informal.notes:
*Winter closure.
.....
Chandos Lake - established beach by the side of the road. 
- Portable toilet 
- Picnic tables 
- Swimming, shallow water but clean and refreshing
- busy during the day but clears out before dark

- posted signs, no smoking or dogs within 20 meters
- cell service

ontario-informal.name: Boat Launch - Westmeath - Ottawa River
ontario-informal.notes: Public boat launch with relatively level dirt parking right on the Ottawa River. Good cell service. Close to small town but quite.

ontario-informal.name: Candian tire shopping mall.
ontario-informal.notes: Large parking lot for a Canadian Tire, Tim Hortons (not a 24hr one) and gas station and several other stores (CAA, rogers, lcbo, quiznos). Several big rigs and other vehicles stayed overnight. Wifi from timmy’s, canadian tire, and others. I did not see a water hose hookup.

ontario-informal.name: Upper Nicholsons lockstation
ontario-informal.notes: parking lot next to lockstation. the lockmaster gave us permission to stay for the night. address is 121 Andrewsville road, there are 2 Otentiks right next to parking lot. Rideau canal next to parking lot Very quiet.

ontario-informal.name: happy tailsl dog park
ontario-informal.notes:
Dead end road.. Dog park and good size grassed area to park. Also right next to a river. 
One night stay type of place

ontario-informal.name: Blind river
ontario-informal.notes: Blind river spot beside community center in the parking lot

ontario-informal.name: Petto Canada Truck Stop
ontario-informal.notes: Truck stop for big rigs with fuel and outhouses. Bit of a grassy area to the side where we pitched a tent. Not the quietest stop for the night but no one bothered us. Could be busier at other times, we traveled during the pandemic and stayed here on a Sunday night.

ontario-informal.name: Rest Stop
ontario-informal.notes:
* Please check and confirm that overnight parking is possible.

Big rest stop. Toilets and picnic tables not much else. Lots of room to park. We didn't stay here but it looks like a good place to stay. Lots of semi trucks and RV parking available

ontario-informal.name: Flying J
ontario-informal.notes: New gas station, showers, laundromat (3$ per load of wash and 3$ per load of dryer.) We have a class B and we asked the manager and there was no issue for us to park in front instead of at the back with the tractor trailers.

ontario-informal.name: Small park w picnic table
ontario-informal.notes: Small nature park just off the road with picnic table and walking trails. Gravel lot of maybe 30' diameter, suitable for vans and cars.

ontario-informal.name: Overnight Parking near park
ontario-informal.notes:
Free Overnight Onstreet Parking. 
4pm to 9am, Monday to Friday. 
Completely open all weekend.  
Adjacent to quiet park. Close to shops, cafes. Rare open parking spot near downtown Toronto for overnight parking. Just be respectful. This is residential area.

ontario-informal.name: Flying J
ontario-informal.notes: We stayed overnight, great hot shower(13$) laundromat (3$ per load) Washrooms. Subway restaurant. Staff are very friendly.  It is a busy truck stop so expect some noise. We have parked on the right of the building as you are facing it on the truck pump side. It is out of the way of the truckers and we had a great night sleep. Ho and they have great cinnamon buns to go with your morning coffee.

ontario-informal.name: Office du tourisme de Val D’Or
ontario-informal.notes:
The office allows you to spend the night in the parking lot at the back of the building. Quiet and discreet. There is a drain station at the front of the building.

L’office permet de passer la nuit dans le stationnement à l’arrière de la bâtisse. Tranquille et discret. Il y a une station de vidange à l’avant de la bâtisse.

ontario-informal.name: rest area/halte municipal
ontario-informal.notes:
parking just off the hwy with covered Picnic tables, benches and washrooms.

Closed in winter

ontario-informal.name: Parking Lot next to waterway lock
ontario-informal.notes: Parking lot that is not visible from the road, next to Lick 20 on the Trent Severn Waterway. suitable for vehicles up to 27' long. View of the lake, adjacent to (but not visible from) splash pad and playground. Fishing from shore permitted in season and with a permit. Entry is from Maia St on the south side just west of the Maria St. bridge.

ontario-informal.name: Gare de Labelle
ontario-informal.notes:
Perfect spot for camping ! 
You have picnic tables, tap water, washrooms and paid shower (but not open during 24h, it was closed at 06:30PM when we were there). 
You can park easily a RV or put your tent.
The spot is beside the CAP 360 trail start parking. 
Just one point : there is a market every Sunday !

ontario-informal.name: Last Duel park
ontario-informal.notes: Beautiful park by the canal, docks, boat ramp, picnic tables. No sign prohibiting overnight parking. Next to a closed (Covid) campground. Complete washrooms with free hot showers open during the summer and shoulder-season but closed in winter.

ontario-informal.name: Rest Area - Dixie Lake
ontario-informal.notes: Space for parking, picnic tables, lake good for swimming. Lots of space for RVs and a few decent spots for tents. Pit toilets and gorgeous views. Just off the highway so a bit noisy in daytime but it quietens down at night.

ontario-informal.name: Ignace Regional Travel Center
ontario-informal.notes: Travel center with bathrooms, drinking water and parking

ontario-informal.name: Whitefish boat launch
ontario-informal.notes: Boat launch and camping, about 20 spots, lots of people, first come first served.

ontario-informal.name: Killarney Outfitters
ontario-informal.notes: Killarney outfitters is a place where you can rent canoë kayak or paddle board and they have a place behind the store where you can sleep for free with a washroom too. Is perfect for tent, RV, etc. But be careful A LOT OF MOSQUITOS !

ontario-informal.name: Parking lot at Montagne Grise
ontario-informal.notes: This spot is the departure of severals hiking trails. Very few people are passing by in the morning or the evening. Very quiet at Night. There is a CCTV on the site but no sign forbiding overnight stay. There are picnic tables.

ontario-informal.name: Griffith Uplands Trailhead
ontario-informal.notes: Gravel/grass parking lot for the Griffith Uplands Trail. Lot is approx 30'x40'. Perfect for our 28' Class C, we backed in. On a rural cottage road with little traffic. Lovely hiking trail through the woods, rated challenging, loop takes approx four hours. No amenities. This is the only ioverlander spot along this road that is appropriate for anything bigger than a small Class B.

ontario-informal.name: Gilles Gagnon Tourism Information Center
ontario-informal.notes:
Perfect little parc to stop by , plenty of space for big RVs ( even possible with a 40’ RV +18’Escalade !!) 
Power outlet, Pic-nic tables, Playground, fake Moose and wolves : perfect for children who need to move after 500 km of road.

ontario-informal.name: Husky - Kenora
ontario-informal.notes:
Husky gas station. Overnight parking permitted on the west side of the building. The back is reserved for trucks. Trains pass regularly. absolutely fine with overnight parking. They are open 24 hours.

Station d'essence Husky. Parking de nuit permis du côté Ouest du bâtiment. L'arrière est réservé pour les camions. Le train passe régulièrement.

ontario-informal.name: Boonies drive in theatre
ontario-informal.notes: Not technically free, but come for the movies and sleep here for $10 extra. People working super friendly. We are very close to point pelee. Watched Batman 89 and space jam. Definitely an awesome experience.

ontario-informal.name: Walmart
ontario-informal.notes: Nice and quiet Walmart location, plenty of flat spots. Tire and lube parking on one side.

ontario-informal.name: 5609 Ellen Ave
ontario-informal.notes:
$5 all day parking, he wanted $10 for our truck camper but agreed to $5. Big lot close to everything could easily sleep in your camper, they don't care.

stopped by here, the guy wanted to charge my $140 for 6 hours or my 30ft rig... I. would say this is not big rig friendly...

ontario-informal.name: Lower Brewer Lock
ontario-informal.notes:
We stayed here one night with a small tent, pretty quiet just near the lock on the Rideau canal! 
Normally camping here is reserved for boaters or paddlers, you can pay 5$ to the lockmaster. The staff is here until 6pm during summer and comes back at 9am, they have the key to the washrooms.

ontario-informal.name: Walmart
ontario-informal.notes: Really quiet Walmart with a large parking lot in a shopping centre far away from any road noise making for a really quiet night.

ontario-informal.name: Esso and A&W
ontario-informal.notes:
Esso, A&W and Tim Hortons
Lots of truck parking, I slept in the Esso parking lot and talked to management and they didn’t say I could stay here. I’m sure it would depend on what kind of vehicle you have. There were people in cars camping here.

ontario-informal.name: Nice place at the marina - 30$
ontario-informal.notes: Beautiful spot near the marina, they charged us 30$ for the night and access to toilets, showers, wifi, water and electricity. Everything is very clean and the place is quiet at night. Arrive before 8pm and ask if you can stay at the restaurant. They had never done it before but were happy to let us stay in the parking for the night. Mosquitos are vicious though.

ontario-informal.name: parking lot right off highway
ontario-informal.notes:
This is a large parking lot w signs that say not parking over 72 hours. So you're good for a few days, but likely noisy due to highway. Check out the other two spots we marked in Bala.
Train passes at 11pm and 2am, can be noisy also. But easy spot to pull into for the night.

ontario-informal.name: Antrim Truck Stop
ontario-informal.notes: Truck stop with a delicious restaurant that sells fantastic lemon cake.

ontario-informal.name: Delaney arena parking
ontario-informal.notes: This the parking of Delaney arena near a park and also near the dump station. Most of the time the parking is empty most of the people at night are using it for the park. Very quiet place and at night nobody is using the parking lot

ontario-informal.name: Centre communautaire Weller de St. Catharines
ontario-informal.notes:
Very quiet location, we had a very good night. No signs indicating a parking restriction at night. Access to a playground, picnic table, boubelle.


Emplacement très calmes, nous avons passé une très bonne nuit. Aucune enseigne indiquants une restriction de stationnement la nuit. 

Accès à un terrain de jeux, table de picnique, boubelle

ontario-informal.name: Woodbine Beach. $15 All Day.
ontario-informal.notes: Ok for overnight parking. Lots of lights and police came by at night.

ontario-informal.name: Depew River
ontario-informal.notes: Right off the Trans Canada highway, picnic tables bathrooms, no running water. Right on the depew River, quiet overnight except for a train that runs past twice.stayed overnight no issues, someone else there in a tent.

ontario-informal.name: Church Parking Lot
ontario-informal.notes: This is a large parking lot by the St. Thomas More Catholic Church and an elementary school, situated in a friendly neighbourhood. There is a big grassy area with a few shrubs and trees. There were a few locals who came by - all very friendly and offered their help should we need it. Quite a few cars arrived in the morning to drop kids off for school, but very quiet otherwise.

ontario-informal.name: Georgian Inn Parking
ontario-informal.notes:
We stayed 1 night and stay parked all day. The owner charge only 20$. It's 100 ft from the beach, stores and restaurants. With our 30ft class A we had magnificient view on the lake and a great sunset view. Georgan Inn office is accros the street.
Street address is : 21 Spruce St, Wasaga Beach, ON
Clean public bathroom at the left 100ft away

ontario-informal.name: Municipal park
ontario-informal.notes: Picnic tables and area where it seems possible to pitch a tent for one night behind the fire hall. Pros: across from a convenience store with beers. Cons: next to a very busy road with loud trucks. Your call!

ontario-informal.name: Rest Area
ontario-informal.notes: Good-sized rest area protected from the highway by a grove of trees. Pit toilets and several picnic tables adjacent to flat spots where you can park a van or RV for the night. Some highway noise but calms down at night. Rogers at 5 bars. Telus at 5 bars also.

ontario-informal.name: Esso Tamiskasing
ontario-informal.notes: Gas station with ample parking. Overnight truck parking, so can be a little loud.

ontario-informal.name: Nestor Falls Picnic Area
ontario-informal.notes:
This is a rest area suitable for RV overnighting. There are clean pit toilets, picnic shelter and several picnic tables strategically placed next to the lake.

There is room for kids to play or to exercise pets. 

The lake is easily accessible.

Very pretty spot.

ontario-informal.name: Westfort Park
ontario-informal.notes: Spent 2 nights here. Quiet at night. Trash bins are on site. Dog park nearby. Friendly locals. Enjoy and be respectful

ontario-informal.name: Halte-camping Ville-Marie
ontario-informal.notes:
Camping stopover open from mid-May to mid-October except during the Abitibi gourmet fair. Drinking water and dump station available at the municipal garage opposite. Free. Wireless. 

Halte-camping ouverte de la mi-mai à la mi-octobre sauf pendant la foire gourmande de l’Abitibi. Eau potable et dump station disponibles au garage municipal en face. Gratuit. Wifi.
Infos prises sur le site web de la municipalité.

ontario-informal.name: Flying J Truck Stop
ontario-informal.notes: Truck stop with clean showers.  Bit on the pricier side, $13 but includes towel and very clean.  Much nicer than Pedro and showers.  Restaurant is decent as well, had the burger. Good pit stop on your way in/out of sleeping giant.

ontario-informal.name: Walmart
ontario-informal.notes: Standard Walmart parking. Park in the left side corner (farthest from store), There's often buses or RVs parked, but never more than one at a time (I'm a local).

ontario-informal.name: Blind River - Parking Lot
ontario-informal.notes: Just past the Tim Hortons off Hwy 17 on your right, there is a parking lot behind some shops, stayed there for the night, which was a lot nicer than the Community Centre parking lot which was a bit industrial. You are a couple minutes walk from a Tim Hortons where you can use the bathroom. Met some other vanlifers in the parking lot, nice a quiet at night... looking out at a little river and fountain.

ontario-informal.name: T&A's House
ontario-informal.notes: Parking available in our driveway. Please do not park on the grass or block our vehicles.

ontario-informal.name: Home Depot, Woodstock, Ontario
ontario-informal.notes: Brightly lit Home Depot parking lot. Stayed a couple of different times while working on my rig. Just off the 401 but far enough to be a quiet night

ontario-informal.name: Walmart Ancestor Ontario
ontario-informal.notes: Large parking lot surrounded by many stores. Canadian tire, Subway, Starbucks, Subway and more. I've stayed a couple of times. Always felt safe.

ontario-informal.name: Parking Lot
ontario-informal.notes: Great location. will have to park in the Can Tire parking lot but there's free Wi-Fi from both Canadian Tire and Tim Hortons. One of the few locations that actually turns out the lights in their parking lot at night

ontario-informal.name: Montagne d’Argent
ontario-informal.notes:
This is a parking spot on the side of the road. It is owned by the owner of Le Relais Montagne d’Argent but you can park your car for free overnight. 
Cell coverage.

ontario-informal.name: Barrie Onroute
ontario-informal.notes: 24h great for one night, with free water even in winter. truck noises.

ontario-informal.name: Metro Parking Lot
ontario-informal.notes: Metro parking lot with more business around. we asked for an employee at Metro and she said it was okay for us to stay for a night. No one bothered us, quiet night.

ontario-informal.name: Grand Remous - Pont Savoyard
ontario-informal.notes: Rest stop just west of the covered bridge Le Savoyard.  Clean, quiet, picnic tables with great view of the Gatineau river.  No toilet, no potable water.  Stayed overnight with truck and 15ft camper.

ontario-informal.name: Collingwood Arboretum
ontario-informal.notes: parking lot for the local Arboretum. semi residential area, picnic tables and garbages in the park, washrooms close by. no signs for "no overnight" parking.

ontario-informal.name: Mont Ste Marie - parking lots / hill land
ontario-informal.notes: Camping is permitted in the main parking lot as well as overflow parking lots. Good for tents/Trailers/RVs etc. Limited privacy and can get busy with campers during mountain bike weekends. Campfires are generally permitted and there is drinking water and toilette available on the south east side of the main lodge. Pet friendly area (off leash friendly)

ontario-informal.name: Free 24 hr parking lot
ontario-informal.notes: Plenty of space right next to river and park and food. Satellite restaurant across river has guest WiFi. But have to eat there to get password

ontario-informal.name: pulp load check up area
ontario-informal.notes: leave place for logging truck if they need to check their load. its a sleep-n-go spot, no view close to the road but flat.

ontario-informal.name: East Elgin Community Complex
ontario-informal.notes: Large gravel parking lot adjacent to the complex. No signage indicating the prohibition of overnight parking. Timmies, groceries, MacDonald’s, fuel, propane all nearby in town.

ontario-informal.name: Super C
ontario-informal.notes:
The tourist information kiosk recommended this place to stay overnight. A grocery store employee told us to park in the back right. Ok for a quick night, noisy in the morning, as near a busy road.

Le kiosque d'information touristique nous a recommandé cet endroit pour passer la nuit. Un employé de l'épicerie nous a dit de se stationner au fond à droite. Correct pour une nuit rapide, bruyant le matin, car près d'une route passante.

ontario-informal.name: Irving Big Stop
ontario-informal.notes: Lots of place to park and sleep for the night. Some noise from the big trucks but we were able to block that out with a fan. We went and asked first but they said no problem to plug into their 15amp power as well as fill up our fresh water. They also have a dump station but due to covid it is not available at this time. Great food and amenities inside as well.  Downside - lots of bright lights around.

ontario-informal.name: Aumonds Bay - Quadeville On.
ontario-informal.notes: Quiet location - camp near waters edge. Tents and small campers

ontario-informal.name: Walmart - Trenton West
ontario-informal.notes: can park on outer edge of parking lot overnight can

ontario-informal.name: 24h public parking
ontario-informal.notes:
Great 24 hour parking spot. Room for full size rvs and vans.

Relatively quiet minus the morning train that passes through.

ontario-informal.name: Marina Kitchissipi
ontario-informal.notes:
I've been sleeping there for 3 nights and haven't had any problems. There are no signs that say you can't. I often see RVs spending the night.

Ça fait 3 nuits que je dors là et je n'ai eu aucun problèmes. Il n'y a pas de pancartes qui dit qu'on ne peut pas. Je vois souvent des VRs passer la nuit.

ontario-informal.name: Carpool Lot
ontario-informal.notes:
Small carpool lot off Hwy 416 @ Bankfield Road
Quiet but for hwy traffic sounds, free to park overnight.
Most carpool lots allow for 7 consecutive days of parking, check posted signs.

ontario-informal.name: Sobeys
ontario-informal.notes:
Parking at the Sobeys, we camped here one night and no one bothered us. There is access to a small beach behind the store.

******************************

Stationnement du sobeys, nous avons campé en Vr une nuit et personne ne nous a averti. Il y a un accès à une petite plage en arrière.

ontario-informal.name: Stationnement municipal
ontario-informal.notes:
Big parking lot
In front of the Canadian Tire/ IGA
Authorize by the city
Drinking water available

ontario-informal.name: Go Station parking
ontario-informal.notes:
Go Station parking lot. 
I've stayed overnight a few times, never more than one night, and I have not been bothered by anyone. 
No signs prohibiting overnight parking.
I am in a small white van, that is fairly discreet.

ontario-informal.name: Canadian Tire parking lot
ontario-informal.notes:
Stayed one night. No “no overnight” signs and no one bothered us as well. Other cars and one trailer were also there for the night. Wi-Fi was working until 11pm. 
Tried to use washroom at Circle K, but even shopping there, staff was rude by saying that there wasn’t a public washroom.

ontario-informal.name: Riverside
ontario-informal.notes: Nice little parking lot beside the river. Overnight parking is permitted. No services. There is a railroad near by. Can be annoying for some people but was ok with us. Wonderful view!

ontario-informal.name: Lakeside Park
ontario-informal.notes:
Parking lot near a beautiful beach.
Free parking 9pm to 9am.
Washroom open during the day and very clean.
No BBQ on the beach.
Amazing sunset.

ontario-informal.name: Canadian Tire
ontario-informal.notes: Much larger back parking lot and less activity than the other Canadian tire. Better for bigger rigs or those towing as well as small vehicles. Toilets inside during operating hours. Groceries and LCBO close by. Short walk for Tim’s or Walmart wifi. Very bright parking lot lights but should be fine if you have window coverings. Little walking path along creek, probably good for pets.

ontario-informal.name: Train station - Cochrane
ontario-informal.notes: Superb train station (also a motel and restaurant). Free short term parking (7 nights).

ontario-informal.name: Port Hope Town Hall
ontario-informal.notes: Big municipal parking lot with signs saying free parking with a 12 hour limit. Great for an overnight. Toilets at beach nearby as well as a rather expensive fish and chips place.

ontario-informal.name: Grand River Raceway
ontario-informal.notes: Raceway and 24 hour casino. Often find RVs overnighting. Safe and quiet.

ontario-informal.name: Almaguin Highlands Information Centre
ontario-informal.notes: Can stop here for 8 hours at a time to prevent highway fatigue, any of the 365 days a year. Closed right now due to Covid but they have refuse boxes, several portapotties, and a Picnic area (covered) also a path and doggie waste stations.

ontario-informal.name: Truck stop Thessalon
ontario-informal.notes: Large park-up area behind fuel station. Timmies and small store. OK just for a quick nightstop.

ontario-informal.name: Masson-Angers
ontario-informal.notes:
Municipal parking.
Quiet, no-forbidden, clean,

ontario-informal.name: Halte routière Palmarolle
ontario-informal.notes:
Rest area, running water for toilets, tables. No camping interdiction. 
.....
Halte routière, toilettes à eau courante, poubelles et petit sentier menant à la marina. tables à pique-nique. Aucune interdiction de camper. Attention, interdiction de se tirailler :)

ontario-informal.name: Walmart Belleville
ontario-informal.notes:
Sign says no overnight parking by city law but I went inside the walmart to ask to customer service and they told me there was no problem to park overnight at the back of parking. There were two big trucks and a fifth wheel.
A bit noisy with the highway close by.

ontario-informal.name: Parry Sound Walmart
ontario-informal.notes: Quiet and lots of RVs around. Good for 1 night.

ontario-informal.name: Rest area at Little Joe Lake
ontario-informal.notes: Large rest area for cars and big trucks overlooking the lake. Right by the highway, so quite noisy. Many trucks stop by and go, some stay to rest and leave the engine on. Nevertheless, I slept well.

ontario-informal.name: Queens Quay E/Lower Sherbourne
ontario-informal.notes:
This is an exterior parking lot. 17$ from 6am to 6 pm. 5$ from 6pm to 6am
Close to highway. A bit noisy but practical because downtown.

Spots are normal sized, but the back row on the lot has a grass area behind it, allowing you fit with larger vehicles as long as you back into the spot. We managed to park there without issues with a 25' RV.

Another guy parked across two parking spots and just bought two parking tickets.

ontario-informal.name: King city on route
ontario-informal.notes:
King city on route service area.

Many business on site: Canadian tire gas station Starbucks Timhorton Burger King and so on.

Just follow the picnic table sign, it will lead you to a large picnic area, separate from the truck parking area and business

Many picnic tables and garbage bins on site and large grass area in the middle of the loop parking area

Open from Victoria day weekend until thanks giving weekend 

See pictures

ontario-informal.name: Gas station
ontario-informal.notes: Located just behind the gas station, the attendant gave it to me!  Logging yard just at the back but still not too noisy!

ontario-informal.name: Zone 4161
ontario-informal.notes:
Public pay parking. There are no «no overnight parking» signs.
Paid parking enforced Mon-Fri 9am-6pm.
Only for 20 feet or less RV.

ontario-informal.name: Cochrane travel centre
ontario-informal.notes:
- 24 hr travel centre
- overnight sleeping is allowed, plenty of RVs and trucks staying the night 
- bathrooms. showers, esso gas, a&w
- feels safe, lots of lights and cameras, we parked near the building 
- downside is the noise, very loud with trucks running all night and people pulling in and out

ontario-informal.name: One stop General Store
ontario-informal.notes: Large parking lot next to the fuel pumps.  Perfect for big rigs.  We had permission to park in the back of the parking lot. We had a chance to run our generator all night for the air conditioning situation.  A good place to rest on the road after a very long day!

ontario-informal.name: Petro-Canada
ontario-informal.notes: There’s a big gravel parking lot with a small entrance built over a curb along the side of the Petro-Canada truck parking (medium to high vehicles recommended) away from all trucks but you still kind of hear them, walking distance to the gas bar, Burger King and Tim Hortons. Great spot for overnight sleeps.

ontario-informal.name: Sudbury Rest Stop
ontario-informal.notes: Small rest stop with washrooms (closed due to Covid). No signs for 'no camping'. Picnic tables, no other amenities since washrooms are closed. Good for a night, right beside the highway. We parked behind the building on the hill to be away from highway noise.

ontario-informal.name: Walmart Richmond Hill
ontario-informal.notes: Signage says no overnight parking without authorization, but we called and they said no problem! no sign in at customer service required. there's a large area around back where recieving happens but they said campers must park in front of the store (not behind). we stayed one night, unsure whether they have a limit.

ontario-informal.name: Pickering casino
ontario-informal.notes:
Casino just opened last month, beside 401 and train but a safe place to park 
888 Durham live ave Pickering Ontario

ontario-informal.name: picnic area
ontario-informal.notes: picnic area just off the Trans canada no signs saying not to camp here great little spot to stay for a night

ontario-informal.name: Lake Ontario Park
ontario-informal.notes:
Gravel parking lot for park users, no signs prohibiting overnight stays. Spent two nights with other cars and class B RV.
Park employees doing their chores without warning us not to overnight. Quiet at night.
Hot showers and toilets, closed at night.

ontario-informal.name: Walmart  100 stonebridge bvl wagage beach  On —-705-442-7100
ontario-informal.notes:
Walmart ask permission before parking, right side of parking lot
---
Walmart demander permission avant de stationner ,côté droit du stationnement

ontario-informal.name: Walmart, Bowmanville.
ontario-informal.notes:
Walmart parking lot. Asked inside and it was fine as long as we parked close to the Swiss Chalet restaurant.
No slides, no bbq grills, stay clean...

ontario-informal.name: Blind river marina
ontario-informal.notes: Municipal marina connected to the museum. Overnight $20 for RV, $15 for tents. Easy walk around town.

ontario-informal.name: Cold water campsite
ontario-informal.notes:
Moderator Note: The User added: 'You need a backcountry pass from Ontario Parks to stay here'.

Right off the highway there is a drive way and gravel road. Many cars were parked along the highway, if you follow the driveway there’s a turnaround by the river and two spots to nestle a car in and stay the night. 

No ‘no overnight parking’ signs.

ontario-informal.name: Walmart
ontario-informal.notes:
*Confirm that overnight parking/camping is acceptable by checking at Customer Services.
.....
There were a lot of campers along one side of the lot. Near the trees/ rock wall. 
No one bothered us. 
There was one person with a tent on the grass.

ontario-informal.name: Georgian Downs 7485 5th Sideroad Innisfil Ont  (Casino GATEWAY )
ontario-informal.notes: Large parking lot of the horse race track next to GATEWAY Casino ,possible toilettes au Casino,et lunch,

ontario-informal.name: Mawley lake Provincial Park
ontario-informal.notes:
Old provincial park area at Mawley Lake. 2019 it was return to Crown land, but still in use. 5 spots available, fire pit, outhouse, boat launch and small beach. 
Stayed here for two days. Quiet, large lake. Walleye fishing if you have a boat.

ontario-informal.name: Parking downtown near King st
ontario-informal.notes: Parking lot downtown near King St. 15$ overnight. For small van only. Little bit noisy at night.

ontario-informal.name: Crown land
ontario-informal.notes: 4 spots available. Currently 3 taken up by RVs. Fire pits, lake access.

ontario-informal.name: Husky esso
ontario-informal.notes: Truck stop right off the highway New Liskeard in Temiskaming Shores, Ontario. Sleep for free. showers at $7.00. a little noisy as trucks running all night but who cares it’s free. guys were nice inside. restaurant on site also. happy travels

ontario-informal.name: Starlight Gateway Casino
ontario-informal.notes: Casino parking lot by the St Clair River and Bluewater International bridge. Beautiful paved pathway along the river and Lake Huron nearby. No water or power.

ontario-informal.name: Cedar Creek Conservation Area
ontario-informal.notes: Nice quiet parking lot with a picnic table and access to the creek where you can launch canoes or kayaks. Enough space to park 8 cars on each side. Slept in my SUV without any issue. No signs that prohibit overnight parking.

ontario-informal.name: Opeongo River site
ontario-informal.notes: Crown land/non-operating park on Opeongo river next to highway 60 enough room for mid size RV or a few tents. Has a fire pit and a rope swing great for swimming!

ontario-informal.name: Miliken mills
ontario-informal.notes: Nice parking spot betwen miliken high school and a football field. Close to Mc Donald’s. A fews cars came in evening for the kids football game but left early. Restroom the other side of the park

ontario-informal.name: Crown land
ontario-informal.notes:
Large campsite near main road next to lake.  Easy access. Allowable Crown land usage applies. Wild Camping - Bring what you need and remove what you bring. No cell service - check the weather in Chapleau

CBC on 89.9

ontario-informal.name: Back parking lot of Jehovah Witnesses Lodge
ontario-informal.notes:
Quiet parking between the lodge and the back woods
Champlain Park with beachfront nearby

ontario-informal.name: Springside park
ontario-informal.notes: Parking lot of Springside Park. we spent one night and no one bothered us. no signs of no overnight parking. washroom and internet available.

ontario-informal.name: Home Depot
ontario-informal.notes: Spoke to the ODM, she allowed us to park in the parking lot over night.

ontario-informal.name: Petro-Canada
ontario-informal.notes: Typical truck stop, lots of trucks, gas station, A&W, hot showers, Tim Hortons and washrooms all nearby.

ontario-informal.name: Canadian Tire Fuel Station
ontario-informal.notes: Site used to be a Canadian Tire store which has closed but there is still a Canadian Tire Fuel station here with a large car park where overnight is allowed if you ask in the shop. We were sent here by the security guard who asked us to leave Walmart around the corner. It's at a junction so a bit noisy, but we slept fine. It looks like construction works are starting at the old store, so not sure whether this spot will be available when it has been redeveloped.

ontario-informal.name: Home Depot in Owen Sound
ontario-informal.notes:
We called Home Depot and asked if we could park here.

They said yes, as long as we pulled off to the side where you enter the parking lot. To stay away from the main parking area.

not bad for levelness.

Walmart, value village, and more around the area.

ontario-informal.name: WINTER DOWN HILL SKIING - Mount Pakenham
ontario-informal.notes:
Mount Pakenham, Ontario: If you have purchased a ski pass for that evening or the next day, they allow sleeping in the back of their parking lot near the portable. (You must be outside the gate because they close it at night. ) 

They ask that you be autonomous, do not use a generator, that you have your own toilet because none are accessible overnight / leave no trace.

We have stayed there on 2 separate occasions with no issues. The best part was being the last off the hill in the evening and the first one on the hill the next morning :)

ontario-informal.name: Overnight parking
ontario-informal.notes:
Small expanded street parking at this place, to spend the night for a small RV traveler, with toilet next door on the quiet street corner, right in front of the Church

Petit stationnement de rue élargie à cette endroit, pour passer la nuit pour voyageur en petit VR ,avec toilette à côté sur le coin rue tranquille , juste face a l’église

ontario-informal.name: Esso Station and Truck Stop
ontario-informal.notes: Truck stop and fuel station.  Quiet during night.

ontario-informal.name: Fuelstation Irving 24
ontario-informal.notes:
Fuel station with large parking. Several large vans parked. We have passed a quit night 

FRANCAIS
Station Irving avec grand stationnement. Plusieurs grosses vans. Nous y avons passé une nuit tranquille en Safari condo.

ontario-informal.name: Port Colborne City Hall
ontario-informal.notes: Large paved parking square that allows overnight parking. Commercial area, but fine for an overnight. Lots of shopping and restaurants nearby. No parking on Friday mornings, the square is used for a public market.

ontario-informal.name: MEC Barrie
ontario-informal.notes: The MEC parking lot in Barrie. I haven’t personally stayed here but every time I come to shop at the store there are large rigs parked over towards the RBC bank.

ontario-informal.name: New Bike Trail Pkg Lot
ontario-informal.notes: Fair sized dirt parking lot for new trails for bikes/hikers. Not well known as it’s just been developed. Very quiet, but watch for bears. There is a pit toilet and bear safe garbage cans. Somewhat level. Experienced big rig driver could turn around. Even though it’s right beside a cell tower, I only got 1-2 bars. There are no “no parking overnight “ signs anywhere. Tenters could easily camp out in the woods. I believe this to be Crown Land as there’s a sign that states (from ministry of Ontario) no removal of wood or harvesting allowed.

ontario-informal.name: Ball's Falls Trail
ontario-informal.notes: A medium-sized pullout along a fairly quiet road. There aren't any parking restrictions posted. It's on a bit of a slope, but not bad for a night. Gets busy during the day with Bruce Trail hikers, so be respectful to not take up too much space. The hiking trails along the river valley are gorgeous.

ontario-informal.name: Municipal parking
ontario-informal.notes:
Municipal Parking lot next to the Moria river and along the walking trail. 
Overnight camping allowed. 
No services other than a garbage can. 

Will fit larger RVs, but you will hog the lot, which may not be appreciated by locals. Bigger rigs should go to the soccer field parking listed in this app…. A pit stop for fishing is probably ok 😉

ontario-informal.name: Municipal parking lot
ontario-informal.notes: Riverside Park parking lot. Entrance road is opposite 254 North Park St, Belleville ON. Entry road goes past city Parks Dept yard into parking lot that overlooks river. Walking/biking path follows river past children’s playground, frisbee golf course and skateboard park. Lots of room to park and maneuver. Mall, restaurants are 5 minutes away. No signs posted against over night parking.

ontario-informal.name: ferme co-op la Hutte
ontario-informal.notes:
This place is a friends place, they just started a co-op farm very neat and they are very open in helping anyone that might need a place to stay for the night in their van during summer time. They have great veggies to grab for the road!
You should contact them through their website before coming.
https://cooplahutte.com/

ontario-informal.name: ONRoute Rest Area
ontario-informal.notes: Hwy 401 Eastbound, huge rest area with gas, restaurants, lot of places to park

ontario-informal.name: Esso Gas Station/Truck stop
ontario-informal.notes: Good spot to pull in for the night. Has parking around back, as well there’s a 24/hr toilet off the back side of the gas station.

ontario-informal.name: Keewatin Arena/Curling Rink
ontario-informal.notes: This is a Parking Lot for the Area Arena/Curling Rink.    Overnight Parking is allowed for a fee of $8.00 CND.  This night that we are here the fee machine is taped up so am unable to pay.  Quiet, close to the water so walk is available.

ontario-informal.name: Truck Inspection site
ontario-informal.notes: Pit toilets, well lit area. No garbage can. Paved area. No signs indicating no overnight parking. Another travel trailer and a semi also stayed overnight. Very few places to stop on highway 11.

ontario-informal.name: Lac Lemeay
ontario-informal.notes:
Free parking and open at night for RV. Beautiful location, quiet in front of the lake.

Stationnement gratuit et ouvert la nuit pour VR. Bel emplacement, tranquille en face du Lac.

ontario-informal.name: walmart Pembroke
ontario-informal.notes: Nothing fancy, the usual Wal mart parking lot. Well, the fact that they close at 11pm and open at 7am is nice. Part of a mall with a grocery store, Boston Pizza, Canadian Tire, etc.

ontario-informal.name: La plage Municipale de Lac Sauguay
ontario-informal.notes: Nice quiet place with a view of the lake. A couple of picnic tables, bathrooms and a shelter. The parking lot is flat and there are not many cars passing by.

ontario-informal.notes:
NO Parking between 2am and 7am between December 1 and March 31.

Outside of this ok. Noisy with traffic, but lot was well lit, safe and lots of room.

Opens at 10am daily.

parked overnight, no signs, No-one bothered me.

Nice little spot with nice view of the lake and great sunset. Three covered camping tables, toilets, garbage can, great luxury! Close to the road

ontario-informal.name: Picnic area
ontario-informal.notes: There are no “no overnight parking” signs. I didn’t stay overnight but stopped for lunch. There are 2 porta-potties on site which were very clean and well stocked with toilet paper and hand sanitizer. A couple of trash cans and several picnic tables. It’s right on highway 89 but traffic is usually light, this is not usually a heavily travelled Hwy. Very pleasant spot to stop. I got 2 bars of cell service (Fido (Rogers)).

ontario-informal.name: St Dominique du Rosaire
ontario-informal.notes:
Nice place established by the municipality. 3 sites only, by the lake. 48 hours max.
Free

ontario-informal.name: victoria county forest parkinglot
ontario-informal.notes: large gravel lot. no no camping signs. lots of road noise. good for quick overnight.

beautiful view near the Ottawa River.

Stationnement de l'hôtel.
À côté de la mise à l'eau pour les bateaux.

ontario-informal.name: snowden park parking lot
ontario-informal.notes: large mud/gravel lot for Snowden Park walking trails. no water, no toilets. Very buggy. Road in is a bit hilly. No no camping signs. good for quick overnight.

ontario-informal.name: Ontario tourist information in Fort Frances
ontario-informal.notes: Since Point Park was closed and there's no other campground close to Fort Frances, we camped with our RV in the parking lot of the recently closed Ontario tourist information in Fort  Frances near the bridge to go across to the USA.  the area is a bit busy but we had a good night of sleep

ontario-informal.name: Walmart Mississauga
ontario-informal.notes: Walmart Parking. quite central but not noisy. Stayed here with two other campers.

ontario-informal.name: Silver Wilow Farm
ontario-informal.notes: A farm for rescued farm animals. Her you can buy eggs and overnight. Very friendly and calm.

ontario-informal.name: path by the river
ontario-informal.notes:
use caution making the turn left off veterans, just south of the bridge by River rd. small turn off, I believe people use the trail for fishing. 
loud with veterans traffic, and occasionally another person, but no one bothered me .

ontario-informal.name: St. Catharines Museum & Welland Canals Centre
ontario-informal.notes:
Large, mostly level, paved parking lot along a bike path and adjacent to a playground with killer views! When I asked if we could stay here, I never dreamed they'd say yes. Their only request was that we park as far away from the building as possible but not in the lot belonging to the hockey ball club. It was easy to see where she meant. 

The museum has bathrooms, but only during business hours. There was a portapotta out front. Yes, the path and parking lot were busy in the evening, but it was a pleasant kind of busy. When we left at 7:30 am, there were 5 other vehicles in the large lot, all using the path. The ships might wake you during the night as the enter and exit the lock, but watching them go through the canal was awesome!!!

ontario-informal.name: Cornwall Aquatic Centre in Lamoureux Park.
ontario-informal.notes: We parked in a 21 ft Pleasure Way overnight.  Asked at the Marina and they said people park in another lot behind the Aquatic Centre but it was crowded with cars and had steep slopes.  We parked on the east side of the Aquatic Centre overnight.   No problem.   Used the washroom at the pool.  Could pay to use the pool and showers. Picnic tables on the lawn, lots of trees.

ontario-informal.name: Tauvette Park carpark
ontario-informal.notes: Very quiet. Nobody bothered me here for 9 days in town for business. A big 12-acre field to run your dogs or watch the sunset. Very nice.

ontario-informal.name: Walmart Oakville
ontario-informal.notes:
Large parking area. You can stay for the night. Dollarama, restaurant nearby.
Wifi, toilet, water if you go in the Walmart

ontario-informal.name: Kingston Park
ontario-informal.notes: The best place for relaxing. Overnight the place is very quiet but busy during the day. Space for all vehicles.

ontario-informal.name: Esso truck stop
ontario-informal.notes:
Nice stop to sleep with an RV on a trip to western Canada.

Belle arrêt pour dormir avec un VR lors d’un voyage vers l’ouest Canadien.

ontario-informal.name: Walmart Supercentre Georgetown
ontario-informal.notes: There is a big crowded parking directly in front of Walmart and other Stores, beside Walmart (not sure if it is still from Walmart or a public parking) it's nearly empty. And it's quiet. WiFi of Walmart still works and there a no signs, that overnight is not allowed. KFC, Kelsley and other places to grab a nice dinner just around the corner. This Walmart also has a Propane Gas exchange & purchase.

ontario-informal.name: The Home Depot
ontario-informal.notes: We stayed overnight here in our 22ft travel trailer and it was a perfect spot! We went inside and got permission from the staff to stay in the parking lot for the night. We were even able to connect to their guest Wi-Fi!

ontario-informal.name: lock 23
ontario-informal.notes: parking lot for lock 23.  no services, beside nassau mills road.

ontario-informal.name: Canatara Park - Sarnia
ontario-informal.notes: Beautiful beach and large parking area. Quiet. Just beside the US border.

ontario-informal.name: Tilden Lake Picnic area
ontario-informal.notes: A picnic are with lots of space and many picnic tables, privies, and garbage containers. No postings prohibiting overnight stays.

ontario-informal.name: Thorah Centennial Park
ontario-informal.notes:
Quiet park but the trains passing are not quiet! Residential area but no houses near us. Many mosquitoes.
.....
Parc tranquille, cartier résidentiel, aucune maison aux alentours, ++ intimité, endroit baignable

ontario-informal.name: W Darcy McKeough conservation area
ontario-informal.notes: This is a conservation area created when the flood control works were created. It is a large parking area with room for several vehicles. It is well shaded and very quiet. It appears that the locals use the area for ATV’ing. We heard them in the distance but didn’t see anyone. Very quiet and secluded spot for an overnight stay. No signs posted saying you can’t stay. As it’s a conservation area, no campfires allowed.

ontario-informal.name: Alder recreation park
ontario-informal.notes:
Parking lot for recreation centre. Close to walking trail. Has 2 out houses. Some traffic noise. 
Sign says no overnight parking from 2-7 am between January 1 and March 31st

ontario-informal.name: Parc marina gatineau
ontario-informal.notes:
Parking by the river
Small park and walking path.
No signs prohibiting staying overnight

ontario-informal.name: Frank tract parkings
ontario-informal.notes:
Small parking lot near the street.
A lot of traffic during the quiet day in the evening
Accessible walking path

ontario-informal.name: Hawkesbury
ontario-informal.notes: Large parking area between the road and the river. Very quiet. There are bathroom and tables to eat

ontario-informal.name: Wigwam Gift Shop and Motel
ontario-informal.notes: This overnight parking cost 10$ per day. It is very informal. Public restrooms, laundry accessible 24 hours.

ontario-informal.name: Blind River
ontario-informal.notes: Gravel lot at the end of Jetty St. Lots of room. Heard some commercial fishing boats leave in  morning .Had the locals drive by till 10. Then all was quiet.

ontario-informal.name: Square Brew Brewery
ontario-informal.notes: Industrial type area near center of town. The employee was very welcoming. I called in advance. There are tree lined spots behind brewery patio, Trails through the forest are start there. We could hear live music from down the beach area. Very quiet site after 7pm closing of Brewery. We also had a food truck there. This is a beautiful Beach front town. There are free dumping stations at several nearby small town. We dumped in Clinton 15 min away.

ontario-informal.name: Trécession halte municipale
ontario-informal.notes:
Nice little spot on side of Hwy 111 in Trécession. Sign indicates RVs welcome for up to three nights as per attached photo.  

Français
Beau petit arrêt sur l’autoroute 111 à Trécession. La pancarte indique que vous pourrez rester jusqu’à 72 heures.

ontario-informal.name: Wasaga Beach
ontario-informal.notes:
*New sign (Sep 2022): no overnight parking between 2 and 8 am

Parking the day 15$ 8h-18h. Parking 30$  the night 18h-9h . Great place with a view

ontario-informal.name: Marineland parking
ontario-informal.notes: Marineland parking is good place for park your RV. I was in Marineland with my children and stayed overnight in Parking. It is very quiet and very nice for sleeping. Staff are very lovely. Today again we are going ro enjoy in Marineleand. You can use washrooms during a day 10am-8 pm and restaurant also in Marineland.

ontario-informal.name: Rapid Valley
ontario-informal.notes:
Gas Station with Restaurant.
Restaurant had already closed at 8, but friendly Staff from the gas station allowed me to stay the night on the parking. Washroom available at the gas station, during opening hours. Even a picknick table outside.

ontario-informal.name: Picnic area
ontario-informal.notes: Picnic area, a spot along the road 117, on the border of Reservoir Dozois, quiet just at night because big trucks during the day, place to swim and lunch, pit toilets.

ontario-informal.name: Chedoke parking lot
ontario-informal.notes: parking lot of the golf club. Toilets available during the day and restaurant that is open to all. We parked at the far end and had a peaceful night. Golfers start coming at around 7am but still very quiet. Next to a waterfall

ontario-informal.name: 507 parking lot 1
ontario-informal.notes: Buckhorn district snowmobile club.  parking lot near highway

ontario-informal.name: Parking lot Mark Street Boat Launch
ontario-informal.notes: nice private parking lot with splash pad, garbage disposal. A boat club rows here

ontario-informal.name: Trent University Nature Areas
ontario-informal.notes: Nature lovers trail. Lots of parking. Does have gates and bears. Roooar!

ontario-informal.name: Prince Edward Walk
ontario-informal.notes: Downtown parking. No signs with restrictions anywhere. Tons of free wifi via banks, shoppers drug mart, etc.

ontario-informal.name: Side of the street by Cathedral park - free parking all day
ontario-informal.notes: Free parking for about 15 cars, can be noisy as some people come down to listen to music and there were a few kids that grabbed my vans handle this morning (I gave them a good scare). But besides that quiet, not too much traffic and good place to overnight park.

ontario-informal.name: Gabrielle
ontario-informal.notes:
Translation: At the edge of the road with a body of water and the possibility of swimming.  Perfect for a night without any bans.  really a nice site for a night on the road because a little noisy.  

Au bord de la route avec plan d'eau et possibilité de baignade. Parfait pour une nuit sans aucune interdiction. vraiment un beau site pour une nuit sur la route car un peu bruyant.

ontario-informal.name: Walmart Supercentre Milton
ontario-informal.notes: Several RVs, a couple of vans and a couple of big rigs on arrival at 9pm. Asked a neighbouring RV if they stayed here last night and they said they have been here several nights, no problem. South side of the parking lot is very close to the 401. There are overnighters parked on the north side as well. Probably quieter over there in the night.

ontario-informal.name: Rest area
ontario-informal.notes: Little rest area near the road. Toilets and picnic tables. No sign "no overnight parking"

ontario-informal.name: Lone Star
ontario-informal.notes:
Had dinner at the Lone Star (love the fajitas) and asked the manager if we could overnight in the parking lot. He said “no problem”. 

A little noisy with planes overhead and a brightly lit lot. No one bothered us. 

We were even able to pick up wifi from the Westin next door.

ontario-informal.name: Former Sears store parking lot.
ontario-informal.notes: Former Sears store parking lot. Close to shopping, no signs say no overnight parking, we parked our 37 ft fifth wheel.

ontario-informal.name: Rotary Bike Park Free Parking. Free RV/ Camping?
ontario-informal.notes: End of dirt road that leads to Rotary Bike Park. The river and major paved bike and pedestrian trail that goes to Hamilton,  Paris, Port Dover,.etc. There are lots of trees to sleep in. There are washroom nearby in the daytime and a gazebo picnic tables. Free garbage too. The city bus maintenance is right next door. Also sports fields near too.

ontario-informal.name: Victoria Mall
ontario-informal.notes:
There’s a shopping Mall , almost closed, big parking.
This is close to the Petawawa Point beach.
No signs of time limit or overnight parking. Very quiet.

ontario-informal.name: Petro Canada truck stop
ontario-informal.notes: Large parking lot behind Petro Canada gas station, plenty of room for numerous large vehicles, pull thru. Gas station store has washrooms and snacks.

ontario-informal.name: Bride veil falls
ontario-informal.notes: Parking of the bridal veil falls. no signs, camp there for a night in a mini van and no knocks. Toilet on site. very nice spot to swim in the river, the waterfall is spectacular. A bit noisy in the morning because of the road nearby.

ontario-informal.name: PP Bar & Grill parking
ontario-informal.notes: Huge parking lot at the back of the restaurant, I asked the owner if we could park overnight at the back and they said no problem we were welcome. Great food at good prices, restaurant closes at 11pm, washrooms inside, closes at 11 pm. Super friendly staff.

ontario-informal.name: Petite halte routière
ontario-informal.notes:
Small roadside rest stop with toilets and tables. Little traffic at night.

Français
Petite halte routière en bord de route avec toilettes et tables. Peu de trafic la nuit.

ontario-informal.name: Walmart Superstore - Kemptville
ontario-informal.notes: Spoke with the manager on duty, they allow overnight parking for RVs and trailers. Overnight Guest are required to park in front of the store at the end of the parking lot as per the MOD. Washrooms are available from open till close and there is also a McDonald’s at this location with in the store. There’s also a beer store, liquor store, staples, marks, Canadian tire, Dairy Queen, Starbucks and a few different restaurants all within walking distance.

ontario-informal.name: Ingersoll ON Route
ontario-informal.notes:
West 401 rest stop.  Lots of parking,  RV and big rig spots.  Fuel and food available.  Indoor bathrooms and a park area.  Pet friendly areas as well.
We set up in a far corner and we're able to run out generator to recharge our battery bank  after a rainy day.
No issues.

ontario-informal.name: Algonquin Highlands municipal Office and Museum
ontario-informal.notes: A large paved parking lot between the museum and municipal office.  we pulled to the back of the lot and we're not bothered.  potable water source at office.  suitable for large units.  Excellent cell phone service.

ontario-informal.name: Bracebridge Agricultural Society Fairgrounds
ontario-informal.notes: We have stayed at this fairgrounds twice now (spring and summer) with no issues at all.  Right off highway 11.  Level parking lot with lots of room for big rigs.  A pioneer village on site makes a nice walk.  Check for events.

ontario-informal.name: Palgrave Forest Area Trailhead Parking (quiet option)
ontario-informal.notes:
A second option for the Palgrave Forest and Wildlife area. This one is on Duffy Lane, much quieter than on Hwy 50. Parking Lot emptied before darkness and filled up again from 8.30 am (public holiday).
Night was super quiet, no street noise, just the forest and some train horns far away. No toilet as compared to the one on Hwy 50.

ontario-informal.name: Husky Travel Center
ontario-informal.notes: St Catherine's Husky Truck Stop Travel Center. 24hr truck stop with large level parking lot, clean washrooms inside the market store,  and a nice restaurant that opens early in the morning. A couple of other RVs were here, and like them, we parked along the outside perimeter of the lot instead of taking a spot intended for the truckers. Very quiet overnight site.

ontario-informal.name: Park N Picnic
ontario-informal.notes: Free daytime picnic tables. Daytime bathrooms.  Nearby Onroute. Quite possible to get away with stealth camping at night.

ontario-informal.name: Walmart in Goderich
ontario-informal.notes: Typical Walmart next to Canadian Tire, Tim's, Harvey's, gas stations, etc, with level parking. Confirmed with store staff and manager that overtime was ok, and they just asked for me to park over closer to the Tim Hortons due to incoming deliveries. Quiet night, I'd certainly stay again. One other RV nearby.

ontario-informal.name: Luskville Parc Récréatif
ontario-informal.notes: Very large parking, close to the baseball ground. Entrance just on 148 road.

ontario-informal.name: Glamor Lake Beach
ontario-informal.notes:
Park is a beach and boat launch.
Camping is allowed but no amenities and several informal campsites.

ontario-informal.name: Rivera Park, Lindsay
ontario-informal.notes: This is a tie up for boat traffic traveling through the lock system. Washroom available but locked at night. Walking distance to downtown. Also has a public boat launch so can be quite busy during the day and obviously parking is dedicated to trailer parking. Stayed one night after boating all day.

ontario-informal.name: Giant Tiger Parking lot
ontario-informal.notes: Spent one night in the parking lot here , the road traffic seems to quiet down around 10pm and tends to start early , if you’re a light sleeper this might not be the place for you but it will do in a pinch , possibly a better place to stay at the boat launch just as you enter town .

ontario-informal.name: Penn Lake Park parking lot
ontario-informal.notes:
The Penn Lake campground was closed for the season so I pulled around south of the washrooms and parked in the public parking lot for the park . 
Washrooms are closed for the season . Nice quiet place and nice view of the lake .

ontario-informal.name: Napa Parking Lot
ontario-informal.notes:
you can park beside of empty cargo trailer

in after closed store,
 free wifi from Furniture Store,

ontario-informal.name: Library
ontario-informal.notes: quite, fast free wifi, small parking lot, not for big RV,

ontario-informal.name: Walmart Bolton
ontario-informal.notes: Typical Walmart in a SmartCentre. No signs at all referring to parking. Especially no can't park overnight signs.

ontario-informal.name: Under bridge parking
ontario-informal.notes:
There is an actual parking lot good for daytime and a vast dirt area underneath the bridge that can be good for overnights. No complaints for 3 nights but I would suggest to park in the parking lot during the day. 

Lovely park and trails near by.

ontario-informal.name: ONroute West Lorne
ontario-informal.notes:
Official rest area, with separate parking for trucks / RV's.

When we arrived late at night, the truck side was overflowing so we parked on the (nearly empty) car side.

ontario-informal.name: Petro Canada Parking Lot
ontario-informal.notes: Not too many parked overnight at the Walmart so we found this spot with a couple other Truckers. McDonalds has Wifi beside it and Walmart right around the corner is convenient. Good for a stop before falling asleep at the wheel. Felt super safe.

ontario-informal.name: P2 parc de la montagne du diable
ontario-informal.notes:
Parking P2 of the park. No display prohibiting the night on the parking lot; access to the park $8 per person. Reception open 24/7, with toilets, showers, kitchen, meeting room. Perfect!

Stationnement P2 du parc. Aucun affichage interdisant la nuit sur le stationnement; droit d’accès au parc 8$ par personne . Accueil ouvert 24/7, avec toilettes, douches, cuisine, salle de rencontre. Parfait!

ontario-informal.name: Débarcadère
ontario-informal.notes: Small quiet place next to the landing stage.

ontario-informal.name: Lamoureux park
ontario-informal.notes: parking lot by the StLawrence river and a boat launch. No signs to say we can't park overnight. public bathrooms. picnic table. beautiful view.

ontario-informal.name: Erin Mills GO
ontario-informal.notes:
Go station car pool lot

Parking up to 102 hours

Close to highway but steady white sound noise from highway 

Good for a night

ontario-informal.name: RVTravels
ontario-informal.notes:
Walmart 302 Erie St S.
Typical Walmart.
Smaller lot.
Close to Point Pelee Park.
Need permission,  no, no overnight signs.
Lots of fast food places nearby.

ontario-informal.name: ONroute Bainsville Westbound
ontario-informal.notes: ONroute Travel Center with Tim Hortons and Burger King. Large parking lot, lots of room for smaller vehicles and a few spots for semi trucks and large RVs. Water fill station on the outside of the building too.

ontario-informal.name: Walmart
ontario-informal.notes:
Parking at the fence line that separates the parking lot from the residential on the other side.
Manager recommended along the fence was perfectly fine.

ontario-informal.name: Blind river - Museum
ontario-informal.notes:
Parking next to the museum and the volleyball court, stayed one night, no issues.

Beautiful view in the morning. 

As a girl travelling alone, I felt safe sleeping here.

ontario-informal.name: aéroport ygl
ontario-informal.notes: gros stationnement calm at night maybe busy at day

ontario-informal.name: Onroute. Hwy 400. South Maple
ontario-informal.notes:
Had a quiet night with only a little highway noise in the background.
there were a few other overnighters as well. there's coffee, fast food and gas station.

ontario-informal.name: Atwood, Baseball Fields
ontario-informal.notes: Stayed for the night. No signs. Very quiet.

ontario-informal.name: Val des Bois
ontario-informal.notes:
Great parking on gravel, no indication ""no overnight" next to church

Grand stationement sur Gravel, pas d'indication " " no overnight " a coté de l'église

ontario-informal.name: Parking lot sits next to the gorge
ontario-informal.notes: It’s a big parking lot for buses and cars. There is NO SIGNS saying no overnight or rv/motorhome. It’s peaceful and a deer came to visit us :)

ontario-informal.name: Costco
ontario-informal.notes: *For costco member only. I asked the manage to park for the night and no issue. He told me to park at the back of the Costco. Place is very quiet and big rig friendly. There is hydro but respectely did not used it since we stayed for free for the night. Does not seem to have wifi. Big store to shop around. A little way away from away 17 but it was convenient for us because we shopped at Costco and it was late.  We parked aroind 9:15 pm and some employees was there still.

ontario-informal.name: Walmart Etibicoke-165 N Queen Street
ontario-informal.notes: Stayed one night. Quiet. No posted signs not to park. Signage says “No Trucks-No Buses”. Store open 7:00-23:00.

ontario-informal.name: Municipal parking #209
ontario-informal.notes:
Municipal parking 6 am to 12 am for 11 $. Free parking from 12 am to 6 am. Public washrooms available from 9 am to 10 pm. Suitable for Vans.
Stayed 3 nights without problems.

ontario-informal.name: Lakefront Promenade Park
ontario-informal.notes:
Large parking lot, FREE, next to the lake, with space for a picnic, some benches facing the lake, a place to let boats down and some tables scattered around. Fits large RVs. I didn't spend the night, but there's no notice prohibiting staying overnight. Today, sunny Sunday, it was crowded in the afternoon.
___________________________________________

Grande estacionamento,  GRÁTIS, ao lado do lago, com espaço para picnic, alguns bancos virados para o lago, local para descer barcos e algumas mesas espalhadas. Cabem RVs grandes. Não passei a noite, mas não tem nenhum aviso proibindo o pernoite. Hoje, domingo de sol, estava lotado a tarde.

ontario-informal.name: Marineland, north pkg lot
ontario-informal.notes:
Great location!! Drove into the main entrance of Marineland, off Portage Road. It was about 9pm, Marineland was closed. Drove past the bldg to the parking lot in the back. Bits of grass growing up thru the pavement, doesn't look like it's used much. There was another car there with rooftop tent. We were with friends; the two of us spent the night in our vans. Very quiet, no issues. Someone drove around at one point in their golf cart (security?) but didn't bother us. We left by 8am. 
You can also get here via the entrance at these coordinates: 43.067446,-79.076492

ontario-informal.name: Jones Falls Parking Lot
ontario-informal.notes:
Very large lot, not actually at the falls but a fair walk away (worth the walk as it's a multilevel lock/ dam combination that drops a considerable distance)
  Don't know why the paved parking is so large, but there are no restrictive signs.
   Washrooms available at the locks,plus picnic tables.

ontario-informal.name: Jennifer’s driveway
ontario-informal.notes:
This is my home, and I have a safe quiet and welcoming parking spot available for one night. 
Cars or vans only. No big rigs. 
Text me at 613–399–5222 to check on availability and get the exact address.

ontario-informal.name: Wakefield municipal park.
ontario-informal.notes: Friendly parking lot with outdoor toilet. Close to many restaurants with view on Gatineau river. Exceptional spring water close by.

ontario-informal.name: Bowmanville Home Depot
ontario-informal.notes: A great place to stay for the night as long as you avoid the side of the parking lot where loading is you’ll get a decent night sleep but they do work 24/7 so you may hear the of fork lift but I slept good hear and they have internet

ontario-informal.name: Sainte Marie among Hurons
ontario-informal.notes:
Free overnight parking if you visit this place.
12/14$ each adult. Open 10 to 5 every Day.

ontario-informal.name: Rest Area
ontario-informal.notes: Amazing view of the lake, picnic tables and washroom. no signage about overnight but not a lot of space (1 RV and 1-2 cars, I would say).  just by the highway.

ontario-informal.name: Durham Rest Area
ontario-informal.notes: Free car park provided by the city with picnic benches a little off the highway. Noisy during the day from cars driving around (and someone rolling coal) but fairly quiet at night. There is a portaloo. Alright for one night but nothing special.

ontario-informal.name: William Wingfield Park
ontario-informal.notes: Park with boat launch, picnic tables, benches and portapotti. Walking trail along river. No parking restriction sign.

ontario-informal.name: Wellington Park
ontario-informal.notes: Had a quiet night, no anti-parking signs. Picnic tables, porta potty, walking paths

ontario-informal.name: Walmart St. Thomas
ontario-informal.notes: Typical Super Walmart. Checked with Customer Service and, although they don't own the parking lot, I was welcome to stay the night.

ontario-informal.name: Gatineau
ontario-informal.notes: RV parking at Casino Lac Leamy. The Casino allows RV parking for their customers. Had a meal at the Casino. Safe place with security. Many other rigs of different sizes. Lots of space.

ontario-informal.name: town of Ripon, derriere l’eglise
ontario-informal.notes:
Small parking lot Behind the church and in front of cemetery, access by rue Major into center of town. Be discreet and leave no trace! 21feet or less. There is also a rest area - boat lauch about 1km north from Ripon on rte 317.
À Ripon derriere l’eglise et en face du cimetiere, petit parking. Acces par la rue Major. Soyez discret, invisible. 
Il y a aussi une halte routiere avec acces a la riviere sur la rte 317 environ 1km vers le nord.

ontario-informal.name: Rest/picnic area off Hwy 7 near Innisville
ontario-informal.notes: Just off the highway. Small area with picnic tables and maintained pit toilets. No signs for no overnight parking. There is a gate but doesn’t appear to ever get locked. Stayed one night, no one bothered us.

ontario-informal.name: Municipal bus parking lot.
ontario-informal.notes: Parked there for one night, we were alone with our class B and had a quiet night. Police drove once around without issue. On gravel without garbage bin or toilet. Near a few restaurants and pub.

ontario-informal.name: Parking near tunnel
ontario-informal.notes:
Gravel parking very quiet, not many people. A tunnel to be visited. On the other side, the edge of the water and plenty of cool space

stationnement en Gravel très calme  pas grand monde et tunnel a visité et de l'autre côté le bord de l'eau et plein de place cool

ontario-informal.name: Super Walmart a Strathroy ON
ontario-informal.notes: Typical Walmart. I called and asked permission and the manager. He was very nice and welcoming.

ontario-informal.name: Tunnel Island Trail parking
ontario-informal.notes: Tunnel Island Trail parking lot,  acces road a little rough, not suited for more than 25' rv.  parking is full day and early evening, clear's out around 8pm.

ontario-informal.name: MTO Rest Area at Hwys 144 & 560
ontario-informal.notes:
Large rest area for cars and trucks on the east side of Hwy 144 just south of the gas station. Well lit, flush toilets and lots of parking for trucks, cars and RVs.

No signs prohibiting overnight parking or camping. Several trucks and others were parked all night including ourselves

ontario-informal.name: Behind Tim Hortons
ontario-informal.notes:
Gravel lot, behind the Tim Hortons, no prohibited sign, quiet, perfect for a quick sleep, motor home 27 feet

Terrain en gravier, à l’arrière du Tim Hortons, aucun interdit d’inscrit, tranquille, parfait pour un dodo rapide, motorisé 27 pieds

ontario-informal.name: Indian Falls Conservation Area
ontario-informal.notes: Parking lot in front of the Indian Falls trail. It is a paved, pretty level parking lot with running water toilets. No "no overnight" signs anywhere, but we stayed stealthy because there is a house near-ish. We were the only people parked there. Nobody bothered us and the first other people arrived at 7ish in the morning.

ontario-informal.name: Kettle &stony pont gas
ontario-informal.notes: Stone parking lot. Was told i could spend the night. Got some cheep fuel

ontario-informal.name: Manitoba Welcome centre
ontario-informal.notes:
parking on gravel ...after 5.00 .
wifi by building

ontario-informal.name: Kapuskasing riverside park
ontario-informal.notes: Flat gravel parking area overlooking bridge and river in central Kap. Walking trail, garbage containers and picnic tables close by. Accessed by first (narrow) paved entry that winds down to river after leaving the highway.

ontario-informal.name: Lake on the Mountain PP Parking lot
ontario-informal.notes:
Parking lot for a Lake on the Mountain Provincial Park. A little exposed and right along the road but has washrooms. There’s a little restaurant just across the road and some rental cabins so would be best suited to van, Rv, or car sleepers who would draw less attention.

This is a non-operating Provincial Park meaning no staff and little facilities. The general rule with these is you can camp unless it otherwise specifies. I looked all around for a no camping or overnight parking sign but found none.

ontario-informal.name: OnRoute Trenton North
ontario-informal.notes: Standard OnRoute with fuel, restaurants, washrooms, wifi, free use of microwave, and all night parking.

ontario-informal.name: Cat Scales
ontario-informal.notes: Behind the Petro can by the Cat scales. A fairly quiet typical truck stop. not too many trucks coming and going in the night. 24hr washroom and pay showers available. Not good for tent campers but cars and big rigs okay.

ontario-informal.name: Stationnement du Fort Henry
ontario-informal.notes:
Really a very nice place to spend the night. Very calm. Young people with their sports car were present when we arrived but they were talking quietly. They left around 11 p.m. Two picnic tables available.

Vraiment un très bel endroit pour y passer la nuit. Très tranquille. Des jeunes avec leur auto sport étaient présent lors de notre arrivé mais ils discutaient tranquille. Ils sont partis vers 23 h. Deux tables de pique-nique disponibles.

ontario-informal.name: Tourism London Welcome Centre
ontario-informal.notes: At the back of Tourism London Welcome Centre, there’s a parking lot before the Westminster Ponds/Pond Mills Conservation Area. Flat parking lot, quiet. No “no overnight parking” signs

ontario-informal.name: Home Depot
ontario-informal.notes: Went to both Walmarts in the city of Barrie and both places had signs stating no overnight parking. So I opted for the Home Depot just a hop skip, and a jump away from one of the Walmarts. No signs saying no overnight parking. No issues.

ontario-informal.name: Halte municipal de Namur
ontario-informal.notes:
small parking for small RV, it's a arrêt nuitée vr, so good just for sleep and go.
keep the area clean.

Belle arret nuitée vr à la halte routière de Namur.
P
our petit vr, gardé l'endroit propre svp

ontario-informal.name: Walmart
ontario-informal.notes: Fairly quiet.  Many stores.  Level parking.

ontario-informal.name: Home Depot parking lot by the curb
ontario-informal.notes: Had a 18 foot trailer and parked by the curb and nobody bothered us.  It was pretty quiet, so much so that we heard music from the store all night.

ontario-informal.name: Walmart
ontario-informal.notes: Usual Walmart. Not Supercentre though.  Good enough for a quick stopover. Spent night with 4 other  RVs.

ontario-informal.name: Quebec Route 111
ontario-informal.notes:
Parking lot. Small space to park, take a break, hike the mountain to Fred. No sign prohibiting staying the night. If you sleep in your car or camp, you will go unnoticed.
.....
Stationnement de la montagne à Fred. Petit espace pour se stationner, prendre une pause, faire la randonnée de la montagne à Fred. Aucune affiche interdisant de passer la nuit. Si vous dormez dans votre auto ou camper, vous passerez inaperçu.

ontario-informal.name: Maxi grocery parking lot
ontario-informal.notes: I asked the manager if we could overnight our 20' trailer and he said yes. Large clean bulk grocery store. In town but quiet after dark, well lit parking lot which appears very safe. Toilet in store

ontario-informal.name: Dundalk Community Center
ontario-informal.notes: Great place to stop for lunch, kid’s playground, lots of level parking, wc

ontario-informal.name: Notre-Dame Town Square
ontario-informal.notes: Community centre parking lot on main road across from gas station. Could stay here or around this area 1 night if you arrive late.

ontario-informal.name: Plaisance Trailhead Gravel Lot
ontario-informal.notes:
no signs that say no overnight parking

right beside 148 main road

ontario-informal.name: Cabela’s (Bass Pro Shops)
ontario-informal.notes:
Large parking, quiet after the shops close. 

Grand stationnement, tranquille après la fermeture des magasins.

ontario-informal.name: Jackson Park
ontario-informal.notes: Trailhead and park gravel parking lot. No anti-parking signage. Playground and washrooms.

ontario-informal.name: Parking behind the library
ontario-informal.notes: parking avec permission du centre d'information touristique de passer la nuit derrière l'église et la bibliothèque, sans service. Nous étions seul, donc très calme.

ontario-informal.name: RougeView Dog Park
ontario-informal.notes: Dog Park parking lot, busy during the day, but dead quiet overnight. No signs indicating parking or overnight restrictions. Good lighting. Great place to stay for a Boondock.

ontario-wild.name: Lake Superior - NICE
ontario-wild.notes: Here it everywhere possible sleeping places aidrekt am See NEM beach! Easy to search. Close to the street got its own beach in front of the door! Not super good spots for tenting.

ontario-wild.name: Lake Superior, near Batchawana Bay
ontario-wild.notes: Very nice hidden place. Sleeping place is so-so in the bushes, but 20-30m below is a lonely Beach on Lake Superior! Top sleep, daytime simply run down and grilling and swimming at the lake. Street you can hear from the roost, but not very loud.
